title: 👑 Becoming PERFECT 👑 #motivation #iuichouston #iuic #perfect #bible
segments: let your heart therefore be perfect. Let
your mind be perfect. Read with the Lord
our God. Read to walk in his statutes.
So this is how you be perfect. You walk
in the statues. So guess what? Job did
it. Abraham did it. It was perfect. The
Lord is looking for those. He got his
angels on this earth searching for those

in his ways. Read. And to keep his
commandments as at this day. That's how
you be perfect. That's who the Lord is
